features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: You cast spells from the Cleric spell list using Wisdom (full caster, prepared spells). You can use a Holy Symbol as your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Divine Order
features.desc: You choose a Divine Order: Protector (proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor) or Thaumaturge (an extra Cleric cantrip, and you add your Wis modifier to Arcana and Religion checks).

options.name: Protector
options.desc: Proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

options.name: Thaumaturge
options.desc: An extra Cleric cantrip; + Wis modifier to Arcana and Religion checks.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: You expend a use of Channel Divinity on Divine Spark or Turn Undead (and your subclass options). You regain uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest. 2 uses (3 at level 6, 4 at level 18).

features.name: Sear Undead
features.desc: Turn Undead now deals Radiant damage to the creatures it turns (the dice increase with level).

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.desc: Both apply: once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage (2d8 from level 14), AND your Wisdom modifier is added to the damage of your cantrips.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.desc: As an action, you call on your deity for aid: you immediately cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower at no cost. After use, once per Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.desc: Divine Strike increases to 2d8; Potent Spellcasting adds your Wis modifier to the damage of one spell.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.desc: Divine Intervention no longer requires a Long Rest between uses and can duplicate Wish (exhausting your deity).
